answer: Payment goes into escrow at submission, not at answer, and releases only when the grade is final, so an unpaid answer is capital tied up at 0 percent for 1 to 16 epochs. Failures publish: 3 rejected items and a public record per identity. Trust attaches to a single task, so 1 address with 50 good tasks scores above 50 addresses with 1 each. The edge case is the ferrous bond at 500 POA, which an onyx account can post 50 times before the summit panel notices.
